rules.check: Was the job sent with useStaticIp=false (admin-server request body; id == k8s job name), or did it run on a node pool not named *-pool-stat*?
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'admin' && $d.message ~ 'Sending POST request to' && $d.message ~ '<JOB_ID>' | extract $d.message:string into $d.s using regexp(e=/useStaticIp\\?\":(?<v>true|false)/) | choose $m.timestamp, $d.s.v  // and: source logs | filter $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] == '<JOB_ID>' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.node.name'] aggregate count()
rules.outcome_if_true: → A4 (if the site blocks and customer allowlists our static IPs)
rules.evidence: 7d: ~37 requests useStaticIp=false (salesforce family, tsn.ca, ctvnews, noovo, superbet, cigna checkout); same jobs on crawls-fast-pool / scans-node-pool; id↔job verified on 4 jobs

rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' | filter $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] == '<JOB>' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 10m), '%d %H:%M') as t aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '200', 1, 0)) as s200, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '403' || $d.x.code:string == '405', 1, 0)) as s403, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '429', 1, 0)) as s429, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '202', 1, 0)) as s202 | orderby t
rules.evidence: booking.com 8ffa9d66: 5,255x202 + 4,220x429, 2x200; never 202→200 for the same URL

rules.check: Share of 429 >= 10% (front-loaded and decaying = throttled; sustained = hard limit)
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' | filter $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] == '<JOB>' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 10m), '%d %H:%M') as t aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '200', 1, 0)) as s200, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '403' || $d.x.code:string == '405', 1, 0)) as s403, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '429', 1, 0)) as s429, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '202', 1, 0)) as s202 | orderby t
rules.evidence: 28 jobs/7d with 429; des.wa.gov 10a3d82b decays 64%→0 in 40 min; booking 37ebce10 ~50% sustained; collegeboard subdomains 20-65%

rules.check: Share of 403/405 >= 50%; note when it starts (request 1-3 = deny list/geo/UA; after N 200s and never recovers = WAF reputation trip; alternating waves = rate-based WAF)
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' | filter $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] == '<JOB>' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 10m), '%d %H:%M') as t aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '200', 1, 0)) as s200, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '403' || $d.x.code:string == '405', 1, 0)) as s403, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '429', 1, 0)) as s429, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '202', 1, 0)) as s202 | orderby t
rules.evidence: 45 jobs >=50% blocked in 7d; lenovo 2df63642, sky.at 95b3a1f2, pbs cb160fdb, nvidia x7; backtest #2903, #3301, #3420

rules.check: If blocked: UA in the job's config dump is Chrome/65 or HeadlessChrome
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'config is: {' && $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] == '<JOB>' | extract $d.message:string into $d.ua using regexp(e=/--user-agent=(?<ua>[^"]{0,140})/) | choose $d.ua.ua
rules.outcome_if_true: → A6 candidate: re-run with current UA; A6 confirmed only if the block disappears
rules.evidence: Chrome/65 jobs 59% any-block vs Chrome/112 20%, but 17/20 blocked Chrome/65 jobs are one tenant (collegeboard 429); HeadlessChrome/65 jobs not blocked; #3340 resolved by UA override

rules.check: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT share = OPT/(OPT+200) per job; >=80% or last 30+ min only OPT at a flat plateau
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($d.message ~ 'failed due to OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT' || $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ') | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate sum(if($d.message ~ 'OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT', 1, 0)) as opt, sum(if($d.message ~ 'is: 200', 1, 0)) as ok, max(if($d.message ~ 'OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT', $m.timestamp, null)) as last_opt, max(if($d.message ~ 'is: 200', $m.timestamp, null)) as last_ok | filter opt >= 20
rules.evidence: aa.com 92% (plateau ~210 OPT/30 min for 10 h after 199 ok), ynet 97-98%

rules.check: OPT share <= 10%, 200s continue to the end of the job, failing URLs repeat across runs and never succeed
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($d.message ~ 'failed due to OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT' || $d.message ~ 'http status code is: 200') | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | filter $d.u.host:string == '<HOST>' | create opt from if($d.message ~ 'OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT', 1, 0) | groupby $d.context.url:string as url aggregate sum(opt) as fails, sum(if(opt == 0, 1, 0)) as oks, approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs | filter fails > 0 | groupby true aggregate count() as failing_urls, sum(if(jobs >= 2 && oks == 0, 1, 0)) as repeat_never_ok, sum(if(oks > 0, 1, 0)) as ok_elsewhere
rules.outcome_if_true: → D1 (heavy pages); if failing URLs succeed in other runs → throttling (A5/A1), not D1
rules.evidence: frontier 2%, totalwine 7% (8/39 URLs repeat), my-rewards 0.4%, moo 0.5%; nvidia 37% of failing URLs ok in another run

still_ambiguous.why: Cloudflare managed challenge returns 403 like a WAF block; no title/header/body size logged (#3420).
An old UA is visible in the config dump but does not change the histogram shape; only a re-run with a current UA separates them.
Rate-based WAF rules answer 403 in waves (nvidia) — behaves like A5 but without 429.
useStaticIp=true but customer allowlisted other IPs: no egress IP logged.
OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT shares between 10% and 80% with 200s to the end (pearson 46%, xfinity 51%).
